data.name: Black Hollow
data.detailed_description:
Black Hollow is a dark fantasy roguelite FPS where you play as a lone plague doctor defending a remote farmstead from waves of plague-stricken villagers. Fight through the night with your staff, lantern, and unstable plague mixtures, then use the remains of the infected to unlock new attacks, potions, and upgrades at an ancient runestone.

The town of Black Hollow has fallen to the Hollow Plague, a strange sickness that twists its victims into violent, rabid, demon-like creatures. As the last plague doctor still searching for a cure, you have retreated to an abandoned farmstead to continue your research. Each night, the infected come through the fields. Each corpse leaves behind plague ichor, organs, and corrupted materials that may bring you closer to understanding the sickness.

BECOME THE DOCTOR THE PLAGUE FEARS

Step into the mask of Aldren, a plague doctor forced to fight the disease with weapons born from the disease itself.

Survive the Night

Defend your farmstead from waves of infected peasants, rabid villagers, bloated plague victims, corrupted healers, armored guards, and stronger boss-like threats. Every night becomes more dangerous as the plague sends more of Black Hollow’s dead toward your refuge.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Defend the farmstead against escalating waves of plague-ridden peasants, fallen guards, corrupted doctors, and grotesque creatures.

HARVEST THE INFECTION

Every fallen enemy releases plague ichor. Gather enough before the bell tolls to increase your chances of receiving stronger rewards.

BUILD SOMETHING MONSTROUS

Combine randomized upgrades, runic powers, alchemical attacks, and permanent improvements to create increasingly destructive builds..

FIGHT YOUR WAY

Crush enemies with your staff, strike from range, throw volatile potions, and unleash plague-powered abilities.

Key Features

First-person plague doctor combat

Wave-based survival at a remote farmstead

Roguelite upgrades and progression

Plague ichor resource collection

Ancient runestone upgrade system

Staff attacks, ranged plague shots, and thrown potions

Low-fantasy medieval horror atmosphere

Multiple infected enemy types

Dark alchemical abilities and plague-based weapons

A grim story about survival, research, and the search for a cure

Black Hollow is about surviving one more night, gathering one more sample, and pushing one step closer to the truth behind the plague.

data.short_description: Become the doctor the plague fears. Black Hollow is a first-person dark-fantasy horde-survival roguelite where you slaughter infected hordes, harvest their ichor, and forge devastating builds before the next bell toll.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for stable performance during later waves with fog, particles, and multiple enemies.
